additional_info.subject: New case [MP / R0 170002548]
additional_info.body:
Dear support Team,
As I am currently unable to create a case in the ticket portal (see error message), I have to open an new case per E-Mail.
A VW ID.7 was connected to the charging station with the above-mentioned serial number and could not be unlocked. A Siemens technician disconnected the cable and the vehicle was towed to a service station, including the plug.
We received feedback from the customer that VW refused to cover the damage under warranty because the plug was damaged, with copper adhering to the pins of the charging socket. According to VW, the cause of the fault lies with the charging station plug.
Please check this or request a diagnosis from the plug manufacturer based on the photos from the VW workshop (attached) and send it to us.
Please find pictures attached.
Kind regards
Alexandra

additional_info.subject: ID0473939-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R0 170002548] Portal Error CRM:03288000194
additional_info.body:
Dear
Alexandra
,
Thank you for your inquiry. After reviewing the situation, we would like to clarify that the charging station does not have a system in place to lock the cable to the vehicle. The responsibility for locking and unlocking the cable lies with the vehicle itself.
As you can verify from the system logs and the cable itself, there is no locking mechanism on the charger to secure the connector to the vehicle. Therefore, the issue is not related to the charging station or the plug, but rather to the vehicle's locking mechanism.
To proceed further, we recommend reaching out to Siemens or Phoenix for a more detailed diagnosis or report.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
